H-LOG: Professionals Report

the cash session (Spot)

  • Index and flow analysis: The market is under selling pressure. The NDX Star is losing 0.41% (29500.01 pts), with a negative cumulative energy flow (CVD) at the level of -63.57 mln shares, confirming distribution in the cash market. A similar trend is observed in NQ contracts (-0.44%) and in the QQQ Dyson Sphere (-0.45%), where CVD is -1.14 mln. The aggregate capital flow sentiment is -8, indicating a clear dominance of outflow across the entire technology sector.
  • Broad market: The Background Radiation (TICKQ) is at the level of -189.00, which, with a SMA200 average of 95.78, signals strong, negative dynamics and selling dominance in the broad scope of the Nasdaq market.
  • QQQ options market: Activity in the options market remains high (volume 4.76 mln). The Put/Call Ratio at the level of 1.03 suggests a slight shift towards downside hedging or building short positions. With implied volatility (IV) at 19.83%, the market is pricing in an expected range of movement between 713.13 – 723.83 pts for QQQ.
